calibration_split.purpose: same original16poses, validate declared stereo geometry/algorithm without fitting depth or rescaling to GT

heldout_split.purpose: same original32 untouched heldout poses; no parameter revision from results

measurement_acceptance.source: Stage6.5 kf.measurement_distance_std=0.03m; P95 engineering allowance fixed at 3 sigma; not a universal camera accuracy guarantee
measurement_acceptance.missing_visible_master_or_model_depth: unavailable; count explicitly, never replace with renderer depth

freshness.source: Stage6.4 yaw.freshness_timeout_s=0.2; not extended for slow inference

truth_policy: matcher receives only real left/right RGB and declared calibration; no renderer depth, skin mask, actorGT, hitID or posthoc fit; GT is separate one-way scoring only
asset_experiment: same matureGazebo/Bookstore actor and original48pose split; only explicitly authorized new true stereo image source
depth_source: explicit native OpenCV4.6 stereo image triangulation; original YOLODepth remains independent diagnostic, no fallback

stereo.input_color: BGR8; native cvtColor COLOR_BGR2GRAY for matching only
stereo.rectification: parallel axes and zero distortion; OpenCV stereoRectify CALIB_ZERO_DISPARITY alpha=0 validates R1/R2/P1/P2/Q; no guessed focal length

texture_gate.source: one8bit intensity code/pixel engineering observability floor fixed before data; not a statistical depth-accuracy guarantee

stereo.invalid_output: NaN/unavailable, never copy previous or GT depth

parameter_source.choices: block3+MODE_SGBM official default; P1/P2 documented8/32*C*block² for grayscaleC1; uniqueness10/speckle100 and ranges recommended docs; num64 from geometric disparity domain, LR1 from sample/outlier check; cap0 actual4.6 source effective15

observability.source: Z=fB/d first-order sensitivity |deltaZ|≈Z²/(fB)|delta_d|; 1/16 output quantization; these establish observability only, not matcher accuracy

negative_cases: left/right pair snapshot/source epoch/sequence/time mismatch => unavailable
swapped pair or negative/nonfinite/zero disparity => unavailable
no common source-time or sensorized pitch history => unavailable
flat or insufficient horizontal texture => unavailable, no hole fill
left-right occlusion/inconsistent match => invalid pixels; original torso median requires>=10 valid pixels
LOST/uncertain Master or acquisition-to-authority>0.2s => revoke/deny FOLLOW via existing authority

source_contract.offline_grid: actual monotonic host snapshot acquisition timestamp shared by left/right FrameStamp; clock_domain=host_perf_counter; MjData static poses are not represented as a running physics clock
source_contract.production: actual mjSTATE snapshot source simtime/epoch; left/right shared source stamp; separate actual host read-complete times
source_contract.phase_semantics: split animation_time_s is initial pose phase; each real repeat adds original .05s phase; final evaluated frame is listed phase+.10s, same as prior monocular verifier

fixed_per_pose_warmup.source: upstream ByteTrack track_buffer=30 updates; original Master3 stable updates; 7 additional fixed updates, chosen before stereo/model results. Global original tracker/Master maintained across poses, no GT ID/reset or wait-until-success.
fixed_per_pose_warmup.scope: warmup lifecycle explicitly differs from prior3frame mono coverage diagnostic; final evaluated phases/heldout poses/gates unchanged

posthoc_scoring.target: median left-renderer axial depth of visible original actor skin within the same unchanged torso ROI; do not select GT samples based on SGBM validmask
posthoc_scoring.coverage: retain failed/no Master and invalid/texture/occlusion counts; minimum valid measurement pixels remains original10
posthoc_scoring.calibration: geometry/implementation checks only; no fit/correction of stereo output against GT
posthoc_scoring.per_pose_evaluated_frame: fixed final third measurement frame at animation_time_s+.10; earlier2 measurement frames and all40warmup frames logged as diagnostics, never used to choose a favorable pose result

runtime_budget.source: fixed before first stereo/model results based on independent saved12RGB original-model thread-budget ablation;4workers P95~.086s vsdefault~.105 and2~.115, outputs validated independently
runtime_budget.opencv_native_threads: existing native build/runtime default, logged calling-thread CPU excludes helpers
runtime_budget.predictor_setup: original Ultralytics first-predict setup, then public torch.set_num_threads(4) in each original worker; actual count logged per frame
